summary: Patch v2 reduced newly rejected edges from seven to three and produced three accepted edges, but a missing relation_type contract check blocked the UBO card from semantic review, CH02 still reused an unsupported source process, and three valid institutional-process claims were left unresolved.

primary_results.result: 3 accepted, 5 pending, 3 rejected out of 11 new edges
primary_results.details: All five pending edges belonged to CH06-S10, whose card failed deterministic structure validation before semantic review.
CH12 qualified result labels were accepted and CH47 no longer generated an active/passive duplicate PRODUCES edge.
New rejected edges fell from seven to three, but five structurally blocked edges increased pending review and were not answer eligible.

regressions.baseline: Patch v1 produced one pending semantic edge
regressions.variant: Patch v2 invented relation_type clue_supports_comparison; the entire card failed P7D structure validation and all five new edges became pending

regressions.baseline: Named institutional processes such as CDD and continuous monitoring were available in the source
regressions.variant: Patch treated absence of a separately named institution as missing subject and left three claims unresolved

issues.baseline: Qualifier gap detected by fixed Audit
issues.variant: Qualified target labels improved, but all three added edges reused source P1 whose evidence did not support the new relation units; P7D rejected them
Both standard-reference and can-help identification edges were accepted

issues.baseline: Patch v1 added one accepted REFERENCES edge plus one rejected duplicate result edge
issues.variant: Patch v2 emitted only the accepted open REFERENCES relation

next_action: Create a new patch evidence contract that permits explicitly named institutional processes without inventing an actor, requires every added edge evidence set to cover both endpoint evidence, validates relation_type against the schema, and defaults to omitting relation_type.
